verdict.rationale: Ghostty's only documented scripting surface is a built-in AppleScript dictionary (plus Apple Shortcuts) on macOS, for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events. That is genuine first-party automation, but it is not an in-terminal plugin or extension system in a language like Lua or Python. libghostty is a developer building block and earns no credit. The runtime probe found no CLI remote-control interface, which limits scripting outside AppleScript. Missing for 10: an embedded plugin/extension runtime (Lua, Python or kitten-style), cross-platform scripting beyond macOS AppleScript, depth of scripting API docs, hands-on corroboration of AppleScript automation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the terminal with scripts or plugins in a real language (Lua, Python, kittens) beyond built-in options

citations.quote: AppleScript Automation: Built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts, and input events.
macOS supports AppleScript, Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents), etc.
